# C01 — OpenZeppelin FungibleToken (kind 3): deploy, publish

<!-- Generated by deployments/tools/prepare-cases.ts --network preview from the examples' metadata.json and the vectors; do not edit. -->

**Demonstrates**: The common fields in one event from an OpenZeppelin token; kind 3 has no color.

**Expected conclusion** (from the case definition; consumer states are computed with the reference consumer, never from a chain observation): 1 kind-3 identity with 3 usable fields (name "Acme Gold", symbol "AGLD", decimals 6); no standards; no color.

- The OpenZeppelin examples publish no `standards`: `standards` is a self-declaration, and OpenZeppelin Compact Contracts claims no MIP. The A1 shape (with standards) on Preview is C06 and C10 (examples/minimal).

## Steps (Preview)

Running the steps writes the run record (`record.json`, rendered as the transaction table below) and the observations (`observed-*.json`, `wallet-status.json`). Shell set-up (bash or zsh; the secret directory holds `preview-wallet-1.mnemonic` and `preview-wallet-2.mnemonic` and is mounted read-only into the signer container only):

```sh
signer() {
  MIP0018_SECRET_DIR="<0700 directory holding the wallet mnemonics (0600)>" \
  MIP0018_STATE_DIR="<0700 state directory outside the repository>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_NETWORK="<Docker network of the proof server>" \
  MIP0018_DOCKER_ENV="-e MIP0018_PROOF_SERVER_URL=<proof server URL on that network>" \
  docker/signer.sh mip0018 -- "$@"
}
wallet_free() { docker/run.sh mip0018 -- "$@"; }
```

| # | Step | Wallet | Exit | Command |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `deploy` | wallet1 | 0 | `signer deploy --network preview --mnemonic-file /run/mip0018/secrets/preview-wallet-1.mnemonic --wallet-cache /run/mip0018/state/wallet1.cache --example fungible-token --record deployments/preview/cases/C01/record.json` |
| 2 | `publish` | wallet1 | 0 | `signer publish --network preview --mnemonic-file /run/mip0018/secrets/preview-wallet-1.mnemonic --wallet-cache /run/mip0018/state/wallet1.cache --record deployments/preview/cases/C01/record.json --circuit publishMetadata --step publish` |
| 3 | `check-event-publish` | none | 0 | `wallet_free check-event --network preview --record deployments/preview/cases/C01/record.json --step publish --expect @deployments/preview/cases/C01/expect/publish.json --wait 120 --json > deployments/preview/cases/C01/observed-check-event-publish.json` |
| 4 | `list` | none | 0 | `wallet_free list --network preview --record deployments/preview/cases/C01/record.json --expect @deployments/preview/cases/C01/expected.json --json > deployments/preview/cases/C01/observed-list.json` |
